A Biker Scouts best friend. This sacrificval lamb justiufies multiplke copies ineveyr Biker Scout deck, and indeed is good enough to justify a few Biekr Socuts and a few Elseks in almost any other deck too! He is simply a [[Ghhhk]] in sout trooper armor! If with anotehr Biker, he can be forfeited to satisfy ALL attrition AND battle damage.

Wow! He has other stats also - but who cares?

Combo: = Power 8, no battle damage or attrition to worry about and if you can work a destiny draw in, your total battle destiny will be +3.
